verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any bulk or batch operation in Canny. The MCP page describes per-item actions such as updating statuses, linking deals, and organizing requests, but never acting on many items at once. Having an LLM loop over single-item MCP actions or the API would be a building-block workaround, not a native bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
